items.title: Glenn Zottola interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 7, 2020
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Bobby Shew just talked about that.

ctx.x: It’s hard. I mean you take a chart, and I’ve played in all the big bands you know. I remember doing Sinatra, playing with Sinatra and Snooky Young’s playing lead trumpet. And I’m playing next to him. I said oh my God, he’s playing these Nelson Riddle charts like nobody else. It was like being in a small quintet, Count Basie’s band but he’s playing Nelson Riddle charts with Sinatra. It was an awakening for me to hear him play lead with his concept as opposed to other great players who I played with — I played with…
Bobby Shew just talked about that.
